quotes: Your Mercenary needs maximum Resistances, Life Leech, a high damage Weapon, and high Defense and/or Damage Reduction to stay alive reliably. Cannot Be Frozen is also a great stat for maintaining Mercenary DPS and leech. Ethereal gear is preferred since it doesn't lose durability. Gear Options at each Gear Level perform equally well in different situations; choose based on Farming Spots and/or personal preference. Gear Level Early-Game Mid-Game End-Game Weapon Insight Hustle Insight Hustle Insight Breath of the Dying War Pike Tomb Reaver Body Armor Smoke Lionheart Hustle Skin of the Flayed One Goldskin Rockfleece Gemmed Dusk Shroud Treachery Duress Shaftstop The Gladiator's Bane Duriel's Shell Guardian Angel Treachery Chains of Honor Jeweler's Sacred Armor of Stability Skullder's Ire Helmet Bulwark Undead Crown The Face of Horror Gemmed Mask Temper Ground Cure Tal Rasha's Horadric Crest Guillaume's Face Crown of Thieves Stealskull Kira's Guardian Rockstopper Cure Guillaume's Face Guillaume's Face Andariel's Visage Andariel's Visage Stealskull Harlequin Crest Cure The Mercenary is hard to keep alive until you have the minimum gear recommended in this guide. Remember you can drag Healing Potions onto the portrait, or shift + 1/2/3/4 to directly feed them a Healing Potion from your Belt. The Mercenary also gains bonus Resistances from Thawing Potions and Antidote Potions. If your Mercenary dies in battle, you can revive them from any of the Mercenary NPCs in each Act. quotes: This is the Standard Best in Slot (BiS) Berserk Barbarian; the balanced jack-of-all-trades version that prioritizes Magic Find while maintaining solid Damage and Teleport mobility, reaching 105% FCR on Weapon-Swap.

A quick swap to Immortal King's Will achieves maximum Pindleskin farming efficiency as well. Highlord's Wrath along with additional Fire Resistance/Fire Absorb makes this an excellent build for farming Travincal.

The Standard Berserk Barbarian Mercenary is an Act 2 Might Mercenary with Insight for Damage and Mana Regeneration. Treachery and Guillaume's Face maximize this Mercenary's DPS without having Cold Damage. Andariel's Visage can be used for increased survivability.
